title: docs(skills): teach os deploy, the managed-package dev loop, in the platform skill
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xBr4PNiYAvCJMKBx5JSNzPr)_

Fixes #30968
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`objectstack-platform` skill 现在教 `os deploy`：`references/operations.md` 的「Environments & deploy」表新增一行（何时用：在组织的开发环境上看到改动；入口 `os deploy` / `npm run deploy` / `os dev` 里按 `d`；如何选环境；`--no-wait`、`--wait-timeout`）；表下一段讲 `os deploy` 退出码 1 的三种读法（写入前拒绝、环境自身构建失败、等待超时）及下一步。`SKILL.md` 的 Part 3 指针点名 `os deploy`。新增 eval 17。
- **为什么改**：PR #30933 已合入 `os deploy`，但 skill 里 0 处提到它，助手会继续教「先 `os package publish` 再手动安装」。
- **风险与回滚**：只改 skill 文本、一条 eval 和 `operations.md` 一行 token 天花板（+179，按裁决实测抬高）；回滚即 revert，无运行时影响。
- **先看**：`skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md` 的 `os deploy` 行和其下的 exit 1 段落，对照 `packages/cli/src/commands/deploy.ts` 与 `utils/install-target.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`，预期 exit 0，两文件读数为 6011/6011 与 3287/3287。
- **需要你做的**：`skills/**` 属 Tier H，需要 `os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 批准。

## What changes

Every flag, entry point and message the skill names was read from the landed CLI at `69e133ea0` (PR #30933, `780c6c34`), not from the card:

| Taught | Source |
|:--|:--|
| `os deploy` builds, publishes `<manifest.version>-dev.<timestamp>`, installs, waits until served | `packages/cli/src/commands/deploy.ts` header and steps 1–6; `utils/dev-version.ts` |
| `npm run deploy` | `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/package.json:13` and `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts:851` (`"deploy": "objectstack deploy"`) |
| `d` in `os dev` | `packages/cli/src/utils/dev-deploy-key.ts` (`deployKeyHint`: "Press d to deploy this app…") |
| Environment: `--env <id>`, else the one `os environments switch` recorded, else the organization's only one | `utils/install-target.ts` `resolveInstallTarget` (flag → active → the only installable row) |
| Kept across `os cloud login` | `commands/cloud/login.ts` `mergeCloudLogin` (same control plane and account) |
| `--no-wait`, `--wait-timeout <seconds>` (600) | `deploy.ts` flags `wait` (`allowNo`) and `wait-timeout` (default 600) |
| A refusal before any write publishes nothing (not logged in, no / several / unreadable environments, local build, non-semver `manifest.version`) | `deploy.ts` steps 1–4 ("write nothing anywhere") and their `printError` lines |
| With no environment at all, create one in the ObjectOS Cloud console | `install-target.ts` refusal for zero candidates ("Create one in the ObjectOS Cloud console, then run this again.") |
| `could not build …: <reason>`, keeps serving the previous build | `reportVerdict` case `failed` |
| `Timed out after …`; install recorded; a failing build reads as pending for minutes; `--wait-timeout` or the ObjectOS Cloud console | `reportVerdict` case `timeout` |

`skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` gains case 17: "I edited an object in my app locally. How do I see my change on my ObjectOS Cloud environment?" expects `os deploy`; its `must_contain` is `os deploy` alone (what any correct answer carries, and in its own `expected_output`); `must_not_contain`: `os push` (the name PR #30933 rejected). No existing eval in the skill teaches the old publish-then-install loop (`grep -n -i "deploy\|package publish" skills/objectstack-platform/evals/`).

## Token budget

Readings from `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`:

| File | Before (`69e133ea0`) | After | Ceiling before → after |
|:--|--:|--:|:--|
| `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` | 5998 | 6011 | 6011 → 6011 (unchanged; the pointer fits the 13 headroom) |
| `skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md` | 3108 | 3287 | 3108 → 3287 |
| bundle total (whole shipped tree, eval included) | 228186 | 228660 | — |

The order measured `operations.md` at 3116/3119; on `69e133ea0` it reads 3108/3108 (headroom 0), reported to the seat before editing.

Deleted in `operations.md` first (restatement, each with its surviving home in the same file):

1. The `os dev` row's "The seeded admin is promoted to **platform admin**, so Setup/Studio work on first login." Home: Common ops pitfalls, "Login works but **Setup / Studio missing**" (auto-granted to the first registered human; "`--seed-admin`/`--fresh` does this").
2. The `os validate` row's "the `os build` gates, no artifact emitted". Home: Verify your work, the code block (`os validate … — no artifact`; `os build # the same three gates, plus emits dist/objectstack.json`), which the row still links.
3. "Both run the same gates:" before the numbered gate list. Home: the line above it, `os build # the same three gates …`.
4. The Docker / Kubernetes row's "refuses to start unless `OS_DATABASE_URL`, `OS_AUTH_SECRET` and `OS_SECRET_KEY` are set" (review S5). Home: Common ops pitfalls, "The official image exits at start naming `OS_DATABASE_URL` / `OS_AUTH_SECRET` / `OS_SECRET_KEY`". The row keeps the image name, "at runtime, never baked in" and the SQLite-on-a-volume line.

Review round 1 (contract review PASS at `965b2d64`, comment 6691650241): S1 eval `must_contain` trimmed to `os deploy`; S4 the `os package publish` row keeps main's "versioned package" (it publishes whatever `manifest.version` or `--version` says); S5 deletion 4 above saved 12 tokens, which S3 spent exactly (the zero-environment remedy), so the measurement stays 3287 and the row is unchanged. S2 (the post-write cases: another install replaced it, an unreadable installation, a publish that reported no install) does not fit inside that saving and is left out; the skill teaches the three cases the card names.

The remainder, +179 measured, raises only the `operations.md` row, pinned at the measurement, under the standing ruling quoted in `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (ruling record 6513306068 on #27847), maintainer ruling 2026-10-27, tap A, verbatim: 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」.

## Review tier

`dispatch-gates` mandates the contract-review tier for `skills/**` (clause ①); waived by the maintainer's standing order in this project (2026-11-03). The seat runs the contract review.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `2586f5ac` (5 paths vs merge base `69e133ea0`): **65 commands**, each run under `timeout 900` with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192` after a full `pnpm build` (119/119 tasks), exit code captured before any pipe → **65 × exit 0** (the first round at `965b2d64` was also 65 × exit 0). `--ran` reconciliation: `65 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 65 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` → exit 0 before each push. `origin/main` is now `33bc8ae5f`; since the branch point it touches `skills/objectstack-ai`, `objectstack-api` and `objectstack-data` but no `objectstack-platform` file and not `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, and `git merge-tree` merges it cleanly, so the per-file readings above stand (the bundle total is this branch's own tree).
